Pending checksum not cleared after a failed deferred write

log_parser:
def parser(log: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    import re

    results: dict[str, str] = {}
    suite = "unknown"

    ansi_re = re.compile(
        r"(?:\x1b\][^\x07]*(?:\x07|\x1b\\))|"
        r"(?:\x1b[@-_][0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~])"
    )
    # Cargo prints these headers with this capitalization. Keeping it
    # case-sensitive prevents "running 31 tests" from becoming a suite.
    running_re = re.compile(r"^\s*Running\s+(.+?)\s*$")
    doctest_re = re.compile(r"^\s*Doc-tests\s+(.+?)\s*$")
    case_re = re.compile(
        r"^\s*test\s+(.+?)\s+\.\.\.\s+"
        r"(ok|passed|pass|FAILED|fail(?:ed)?|error|errored|"
        r"ignored|skipped|skip|timeout|timed out|aborted)"
        r"(?:\s*,.*)?\s*$",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )

    def binary_name(path: str) -> str:
        name = re.split(r"[/\\]", path.strip().strip("\"'"))[-1]
        name = re.sub(r"\.exe$", "", name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        name = re.sub(r"-[0-9a-f]{8,}$", "", name, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        return name or "unknown"

    for raw_line in log.splitlines():
        line = ansi_re.sub("", raw_line).replace("\r", "")

        match = doctest_re.match(line)
        if match:
            suite = "doctest:" + match.group(1).strip()
            continue

        match = running_re.match(line)
        if match:
            description = match.group(1).strip()
            executable = re.search(r"\(([^()]*)\)\s*$", description)
            suite = (
                binary_name(executable.group(1))
                if executable
                else description
            )
            continue

        match = case_re.match(line)
        if not match:
            continue

        name, raw_status = match.groups()
        normalized = raw_status.lower()
        if normalized in {"ok", "pass", "passed"}:
            status = "pass"
        elif normalized in {"ignored", "skip", "skipped"}:
            status = "skip"
        else:
            status = "fail"

        results[f"{suite}::{name.strip()}"] = status

    return results
